units.source_text: 不久天色渐明，鸡声报晓。

en.t: Before long, the sky began to brighten, and the rooster's crow announced the dawn.

units.source_text: 此处地近大路，户外人声嘈杂。

en.t: This place was close to the main road, and the voices outside were loud and confused.

units.source_text: 但闻叫卖之人成群来往，而听不懂所喊的是什么物名。

en.t: He could only hear groups of peddlers coming and going, though he could not make out what wares they were calling out.

units.source_text: 薰大将想象：在这黎明时分，头上顶着货物而叫卖的商人，形容都像鬼怪。

en.t: Kaoru imagined that, at this dawn hour, the merchants crying their wares with loads balanced on their heads must all look like apparitions.

units.source_text: 他从来不曾在这种蓬门草舍中宿过夜，觉得别有趣味。

en.t: He had never spent a night in such a poor, rustic dwelling before, and he found it oddly interesting.

units.source_text: 后来听见这里守夜的人开门出去，各自回室中去休息了，

en.t: Later, he heard the night watchmen there open the doors and go out, then return to their own rooms to rest.

units.source_text: 他就召唤随从人夫，把车子赶到边门口来，自己抱了浮舟登车。

en.t: He then summoned his attendants, had the carriage brought to the side gate, and carried Ukifune into it himself.

units.source_text: 事出意外，这里的人不胜骇怪，喧吵起来：

en.t: Because it was so unexpected, the people there were utterly startled and began making a commotion.

units.source_text: “现在是不宜结婚的九月里，这事情使不得啊！

en.t: "This is the ninth month, when marriages are inauspicious; this must not be done!

units.source_text: 怎么办呢？”

en.t: What are we to do?"

units.source_text: 大家很着急。

en.t: Everyone was terribly anxious.

units.source_text: 弁君也意想不到，很可怜浮舟；

en.t: Ben no Kimi, too, had not expected this, and she felt very sorry for Ukifune.

units.source_text: 但她安慰众人，说道：“大将自有主意，大家不必担心。

en.t: But she comforted the others, saying, "The General surely has his own plan, so there is no need for anyone to worry.

units.source_text: 我知道明天才交九月的节气。”

en.t: I know that the seasonal turning point into the ninth month does not come until tomorrow."

units.source_text: 原来今天是十三日。

en.t: In fact, that day was the thirteenth.

units.source_text: 弁君又对薰大将说：“今天我不能奉陪了。

en.t: Ben no Kimi then said to General Kaoru, "I cannot accompany you today.

units.source_text: 二小姐定会闻知此事。

en.t: The Second Lady is sure to hear of this matter.

units.source_text: 我若不去拜访，悄悄地来了就回去，太失礼了。”

en.t: If I do not visit her, but simply come and go in secret, it would be terribly rude."

units.source_text: 薰大将以为现在还早，立刻把此事告知二女公子，

en.t: General Kaoru thought it was still early, and that immediately informing the Second Lady of the matter

units.source_text: 似觉难以为情，答道：“你以后再向她道歉吧。

en.t: would seem awkward, so he replied, "You can apologize to her later.

units.source_text: 今天到那边去，如果没有人引导，很不方便。”

en.t: If we go there today without someone to guide us, it will be very inconvenient."

units.source_text: 他强要弁君同去。

en.t: He insisted on making Ben no Kimi go with them.

units.source_text: 又说：“再带一个侍女去才好。”

en.t: He also said, "It would be best to take one more maidservant along."

units.source_text: 便选定浮舟身边一个名叫侍从的侍女，叫她和弁君同乘。

en.t: So he chose a maidservant who attended Ukifune, named Jiju, and had her ride together with Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 乳母和弁君带来的女童，都留在这里，她们都弄得莫名其妙。

en.t: The nurse and the young girl whom Ben no Kimi had brought were both left behind there, and they were completely bewildered.
